info.title: id-proto-debugger API
info.description:
The id-proto-debugger api: a guarded proxy and relay for the protocol
workflows a browser cannot complete on its own. Every endpoint that
connects anywhere does so to a target its caller names, under the address
policy, timeouts and caps of the api's configuration.

get.description:
The IANA "JSON Web Token Claims" registry, as IANA publishes it (XML),
fetched once and kept for the life of the process. The token page labels
the claims it shows from it.

body.description: As received, cut at the api's trace limit.

OAuth.ExchangeResponse.description: The far end's answer, in the trace.

http_exchange.description:
Present when the caller asked for http_trace, on /token and
/tokenexchange. `response` is null in it.

OAuth.Failure.description:
The api's own failure: the far end could not be reached or gave no
answer (a name that does not resolve, a refused connection, a timeout, a
body past maxContentLength, too many redirects, a blocked address or
scheme), or the call could not be made at all. `error` is an object only
where a handler's last-resort catch serialized an Error, which is `{}`.

OAuth.HttpExchange.description:
The HTTP exchange the api had with the far end (buildHttpTrace() in
api/server.js): the request as SENT, User-Agent and any Authorization
header included; the response, or null when none came back; how long
the outbound call took; and why it failed, when it did.

OAuth.IntrospectionAnswer.description: An introspection response (RFC 7662 section 2.2), as sent.

OAuth.IntrospectionRequest.description:

held, because the api relays a non-conforming one unchanged.

the server answer 200 with an empty body, so the api says what happened

authorization_code, client_credentials, password, refresh_token or

Refusal.description:
A request this service refused, or a call it could not complete. `error`
is a sentence for a person; `code`, where the endpoint has one, is the
stable name a caller branches on.

Service.ModelGap.description:
One answer that did not match its operation's response schema. Recorded
only where `validateResponses` is on, which is a test configuration; the
answer itself was sent unchanged. No member value is recorded, only where
the schema and the answer disagreed, because an answer can carry a token.

Service.ModelGaps.description: Every recorded gap since the process started.

servers.description: The api's own origin. Embedded, it is the debugger's origin + /api.
